purpose: source-only compilation, then four formal queries on the same artifact leave the source hash unchanged; an unsupported source unit is never silently dropped
text: Ann is a person. Ann is in Haapsalu. There is a bus service from Haapsalu to Tallinn. There is a ship service from Tallinn to Helsinki.

units.text: There is a bus service from Haapsalu to Tallinn.
There is a ship service from Tallinn to Helsinki.

expect.evidence: compile_source with no query runs no GK and invents no question; the artifact records source hash H, entity identities, profile and library versions, supported status

queries.text: How can Ann get to Helsinki?

expect.evidence: library default for a person; two public connections; the source hash H recorded by Q0 is unchanged after attachment

queries.text: Can Ann reach Tallinn in at most one action?

expect.evidence: seed 1; the bus leg; source hash unchanged

queries.text: After Ann takes the bus to Tallinn and the ship to Helsinki, is Ann in Helsinki?

expect.evidence: both steps executable in sequence; the goal holds at W0+2; source hash unchanged

queries.text: How can Ann get to Tartu?

expect.evidence: Tartu 5 is not in the source artifact's identity context; a query may bind a variable with a type requirement, never introduce an initial entity, route or permission (A3.1). A dangling ground constant is a query validation failure, not not_found (REVIEW.md disposition 4). A future query interface may declare a query-only constant explicitly; even then no route or location for it is added.
no source entity is a port; the goal adds a bound variable and a type requirement, not a port

variants.text: Ann is a person. Ann is in Haapsalu. There is a bus service from Haapsalu to Tallinn. There is a ship service from Tallinn to Helsinki. Ann sang in Tallinn yesterday.

compile.detail: a narrative occurrence is recognized and reported, not executed or turned into an ability (A2.6, A7.1)

expect.evidence: the artifact keeps S5 marked unsupported; the source is not source_compiled
query attachment must not turn partial compilation into a planning problem by omitting S5 (A3.1)

explain: This is the travel pilot used as the reuse regression. The observable is the source hash H recorded by Q0 and unchanged after each of Q1, Q2 and Q4, plus the input-view hash each of them records. Q5 and Q6 pin that a query cannot add entities. The variant pins the other half of C14: an unsupported unit blocks source_compiled and every query, and is still in the artifact.
notes: Companion c28_snapshot_view pins the content of the snapshot input view. Amended 2026-09-23 (encoding v2, gold review 0.4): Q3 (ability independent of Ann's location) is removed; a direct executable question would change a Yes ability question into an immediate executability question.
